name: bird-dog-with-band-rnt
instructions:
1. Assume a quadruped position with your knees under hips, hands under shoulders, and toes tucked.
2. Attach a band to the opposite foot and hand.
3. Extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping your hips and torso stable.
4. Slowly lower the arm and leg back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
